question:
Choose the correct phrasal verb:

The researcher failed to _____ a firm conclusion from the results.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"arrive at"** means to reach a decision, conclusion, or understanding about something. (किसी निर्णय या निष्कर्ष पर पहुँचना)
 
 
• **Example: **The committee will need more time to arrive at a final decision.
 
 
• In the context of the question, the researcher failed to "arrive at" a firm conclusion, meaning they could not reach a definite or clear result.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Draw out** (निकालना): To encourage someone to reveal or explain more about their thoughts or feelings.
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher tried to draw out the shy student by asking open-ended questions.
 
 
 
• **Bring up** (उठाना): To mention or introduce a topic in conversation.
 
 
• **Example: **She decided to bring up the issue of pay during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Make over** (बदलाव करना): To change or improve something, often referring to appearance or style.
 
 
• **Example: **The interior designer made over the living room to give it a modern look.
